ethnicity.notes: Processing prohibited absent an Art. 9(2) lawful basis. Consent in employment is generally invalid (EDPB Guidelines 05/2020). EU AI Act Art. 10(5) permits processing strictly for bias detection in high-risk AI (recruitment is Annex III §4).

health.notes: Lawful only for an Art. 9(2) basis; pre-employment medical inquiries are tightly limited and must be job-essential.

genetic.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 9(1); Member State law often forbids in employment
genetic.notes: Several Member States flatly prohibit in employment (e.g. France Art. L1132-1 Code du travail).

biometric.legal_basis: GDPR Art. 9(1) when used for identification

pregnancy.notes: Asking about pregnancy in recruitment is per-se direct sex discrimination across the EU.

ethnicity_self_id.legal_basis: EU AI Act Art. 10(5); some MS allow equality monitoring

criminal_record.notes: Processing of criminal-conviction data requires Member State legal basis; not generally available to private employers.

salary_history.notes: EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU 2023/970) limits employer use; applicants cannot be required to disclose pre-hire from June 2026.
